title: Explicit prime counting: numerically explicit bounds for ψ, θ, π, the n-th prime, sums over primes, primes in progressions and short intervals
summary: Explicit transfer identities between ψ, θ, π and Li; the computational hypotheses as named propositions; bounds under RH and RH to a height; the general unconditional scheme (region, verified height, zero count, zero density) and its published instances (Rosser–Schoenfeld, Schoenfeld, Dusart, Faber–Kadiri, Trudgian, Platt–Trudgian, Johnston–Yang, Fiori–Kadiri–Swidinsky); explicit Mertens and prime-power sums; the n-th prime; primes in progressions (Ramaré–Rumely, Dusart, McCurley, Bennett–Martin–O'Bryant–Rechnitzer, Ramaré, Bach–Sorenson, Kadiri); short intervals (Schoenfeld, Ramaré–Saouter, Kadiri–Lumley, Cully-Hugill–Lee, Trudgian, Axler, Dudek, Cully-Hugill).
